## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload image-classification --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload image-classification --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload image-classification --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload image-classification --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

## Candidate Quality Target

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | top1_accuracy |
| **Target** | 0.85 |
| **Direction** | higher |
| **Target basis** | mlcommons_derived |
| **Tolerance** | 0.0 |
| **Reference runs** | 0 |

**Reviewer notes:**

- The 85% gate is inherited from MLPerf Tiny; it is not inferred from a project-created calibration.
- The exact official float checkpoint reproduces 87.0% on the 200-sample accuracy set through the PyTorch adapter; promotion still requires a committed five-run timing sweep.
- The measured region repeats the unchanged accuracy-set pass 50 times so laptop timing is long enough for the 5% outer-run repeatability gate; quality is computed from the first pass only.

## Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Within-run measurement protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Primary metric** | inference_and_evaluation_seconds |
| **Scenario** | offline |
| **Timing scope** | 50 complete passes over the official 200-sample MLPerf Tiny accuracy set after model and data construction |
| **Included phases** | host-to-device transfer of raw float CIFAR-10 inputs for every pass, exact PyTorch execution of the fused official float ResNet8 graph for every pass, top-1 prediction for every pass and accuracy accumulation for the first pass |
| **Excluded phases** | dataset fetching, Parquet decoding and accuracy-subset construction, TFLite parsing and PyTorch weight loading, one untimed warmup for each observed batch shape, report and provenance serialization |
| **Device synchronization** | synchronize immediately before and after the measured inference-and-evaluation region |
| **Outer reference runs** | 5 |
| **Repeatability metric** | inference_and_evaluation_seconds |
| **Repeatability limit** | 0.05 |
